content: Isal a antööm bàkwem aŋiyweel
Yɛsu kàtüüb antööm bàkwem aŋiyweel, waa kapɛ ngwal anà ikɔ̈b muböŋ insɔŋà myanswà anà mukɔɔr an'kyal.
Ungö apan, waa katöm mukàpay làsaŋ a Imwol a Nzam anà mukɔɔr an'kyal.
Nde kàtɛn a ba naa: « Twon lan'wal undiir ntɔn mbwo: itàkal unsɔk, itàkal ngɔɔr, itàkal isaa, itàkal ngim. Twon lan'syen inkur byeel.
Isàkal naa bàmàlawal u ndwà mwɛy, làbwaay apan tii taaŋ làsàlwomà bɛ kà ikal akin.
Isàkal naa mbuur kàlawɛl anki, làlwomà u bul alan, sàlàkɔɔb un'twà a in'kɔl abɛ: kya isàkal imbäl ibe ntɔn ba. »
Apan, alɔŋki bàkyen ba, ba bàyilyaaŋà bul a bul muyikyään Làsaŋ Aŋàbwaŋ anà muyikɔɔr abɛy.
An'kyän a Ɛlɔdi
Mfum Ɛlɔdi kàwem nde ndaa ayi yanswà, nde kàyweerà naa nde akyer aben. Ntɔn baar mbɔɔn bàtɛɛnà naa Ywan kan'wiyà,
bumwɛy naa Ԑlya kan'fàmɛnà, wɛɛ bumwɛy naa umwɛy uboo a aŋangɔɔm bà itaan kan'wiyà.
Wɛɛ Ɛlɔdi kàtɛɛnà naa: « Mɛ Ywan kàkyun'tsul un'tswe: nà mbuur wa in'fiweemà mɛ làsaŋ a tub lalɛy? » Nde kàleŋà mukun'man.
Yɛsu kan'dii abaal nsaab tyeen
Mpal bàyàfurà antööm, ba bàkyäänà Yɛsu indiir byanswà bàkyer ba. Nde kawɛl, waa kasyen ukɔl, u bul mwɛy ikɔb a la Bɛtesayidà.
Baar mbɔɔn bàyöb ba naa Yɛsu anà alɔŋki ande bà u bul alan, laa baläb ba. Yɛsu kawɛl nde, laa kakyäänà nde ndaa a imwol a Nzam. Nde kàkɔɔr sye baar bàkäl anà ngyal akɔɔrà.

Mpal bàmɛn antööm bàkwem aŋiyweel naa taaŋ lan'sɛmà muminà, ba bàsin tsütsü apà Yɛsu, waa bun'kyään naa: « Apay baar, ba bàkyen kà an'bul anà u bitsuŋ a ndwà byà tsütsü ntɔn ba bàkàleŋ ikal abɔ̈ɔ̈n anà isaa adyà ntɔn bi apà ibà u nsye a ipɔl. »
Yɛsu waa kafuur naa: « La pɛ udyà bɛ ŋakwo. » Ba waa bun'fuur naa: « Bi iwe amà mampà tyeen anà nsö yweel, tɛn naa bi ŋakwo ikàsom isaa ntɔn mbul a baar wà. »
Abaal bàkäl isii a nsaab tyeen. Yɛsu naa: « Làswɛŋ baar bàbwaay an'kwem an'tyeen, an'kwem an'tyeen. »
Ba bàkyer abun, bàpɛ baar banswà ikal abwaay.
Yɛsu kàwɛl mampà mà an'tyeen anà nsö yàyweel, waa kàler u du, kàfuur an'tɔɔn akà Nzam. Ungö apan waa kàtsül mampà anà nsö, waa kàpɛ alɔŋki ande ntɔn mupà akà baar banswà.
Baar banswà waa bàdi, bàyüür. Itiir a mampà byàsäl mbɔↄn, bya byàyööl in'lwaŋ kwem aŋiyweel.
Petɔlà kan'tɛn naa Yɛsu wà Un'tswää a mɔ̈ɔ̈
Ilä mwɛy Yɛsu kàkäl muyamà u mpey anà alɔŋki ande, waa kafuul naa: « Baar bàfàtɛn naa mɛ in'wà nà? »
Ba bàfuur naa: « Ywan Un'düümà, bumwɛy, Ԑlya, bumwɛy, umwɛy uboo a aŋangɔɔm kan'wiyà. »
Nde waa kafuul naa: « Wɛɛ bɛ ŋakwo làtɛn naa mɛ in'wà nà? » Petɔlà waa kàfuur naa: « Ngye awà Klistɔ a Nzam. »
Yɛsu kan'kyään nkweel ande anà ngwiiyà ande
Yɛsu katsüŋ mukyään mbuur akà ikikye.
Nde waa kàfàkwɛy naa: « Mwan a mbuur akyer aman mpay mbɔɔn. Andweer, amfum a angaŋ anà alɔɔŋ a in'kɔɔn bàkyer un'tɔn, bàkyer un'dwa, waa ilä kyàtär nde akyer awiyà. »
Ungö, nde waa kàtɛn akà baar banswà: « Isàkal naa mbuur akwen mukan'lab, wɛy nde ukɔɔb ndür ande, usɛn buur ande ilä byanswà, wɛy nde kan'läb.
Ntɔn mbuur usàkwen muyee möö ande, wa asàkyà bwà. Wɛɛ mbuur usàpiy möö ande ntɔn mɛ, nde asàtswà wa.
Bweel nà mbuur kan'kwo muwal isàkal naa nde kan'wal mɛɛn manswà, wɛɛ mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande ukyà bwà?
Mbuur usàwem mɛ nswɛn anà ndaa amɛ, Mwan a mbuur sye asun'wem nswɛn mpal usàyà nde unsà làkoo ande anà là Taa anà là akyeey in'kyɛɛl.
Ndandaa mɛ alàkyään, bàmbɔɔn uboo abɛ bàyàkal aŋàtàkwà anki kusà muman Imwol a Nzam. »
Ngyoolà a Yɛsu
Kà isii a ilä naan ungö a ndaa ayi, Yɛsu kàwɛl Petɔlà, Ywan anà Zyak, nde kàlär udu a mɔŋ ntɔn mukàyamà.
Mpal kàkäl nde muyamà, ntabwey ande waa yàsɔɔmà, ipfɛy ande kyàbulà kyà in'ŋyäŋ a pɛɛl.
Apan, baar bɔ̈ɔ̈l bàkäl muyääm anà nde, ba bàkäl Mɔsɛ anà Ԑlya,
ban'yàmɛnà uboo a làkoo, bàmuyäämà ndaa ukàmay Yɛsu isal ande u Yɛlusàlɛm u mbwo a nkweel ande.
Petɔlà anà bumwɛy bàkäl anà nde bàbɔ̈ɔ̈n twaal aŋàkir. Umpal bàsubà ba, ba bàmɛn làkoo a Yɛsu anà baar bööl bàkäl anà nde.

Umpal bàkaabà baar aban anà Yɛsu, Petɔlà kàtɛn a nde naa: « Un'lɔɔŋ, yà ubwaŋ naa bi ikäl apà, bi imbaar ntɛn, ntɛn tär: mwɛy ntɔn ngye, mwɛy ntɔn Mɔsɛ anà mwɛy ntɔn Ԑlya. » Kutɛn aŋàbwaŋ nde kàyöb anki undiir kàtɛɛnà nde.
Umpal kàkäl nde mutɛn, un'böŋ mwɛy waa kafwee. Alɔŋki bàkäl u bɔɔmà mpal bàmɛn ba naa ba ban'bilà uboo a un'böŋ.
Uboo a un'böŋ ndaa waa itoo, waa itɛn naa: « Awà mwan amɛ, mwan kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l mɛ. Lun'wem! »
Ungö a ndaa ayi, ba bàsàman Yɛsu aŋàyen mpɛl. Wɛɛ mpal ayin, ndaa ayi yanswà ba bàkäärà u mpem, ba akà mbuur mwɛy bàkyään anki.
Yɛsu kan'kɔɔr mwan kàkäl anà dweelà a làbe
Taaŋtyà, ba bàkäl muyàtyà u mɔŋ, baar mbɔɔn bàyi mubwey a Yɛsu.
Waa le, uboo a baar abà, mbuur mwɛy kàlal in'kwɛŋ: « Un'lɔɔŋ, mɛ amabɔɔn, un'ler mwan baal amɛ! Mwan baal mwɛy awà mpɛl.
Dweelà a làbe làsun'bilà, kà imbürà nde asà in'kwɛŋ, laa lun'bwiy la, waa ugyɔrà an'te. La làfun'wɛy anki agyä, nde afàkwà lɛy.
Mɛ an'bɔɔn alɔŋki angye naa ba bun'böŋ, wɛɛ ba bàsàkwo anki. »
Yɛsu waa kaŋän: « Bɛ làbà baar làkɔ̈ɔ̈n làkwikilà, baar abe! mɛ anà bɛ ilä ikwɛ in'yàfàkal anà mukàlakaar? » Waa ubulà akà mbuur awun: « Un'twääl mwan angye! »
Umpal kàkäl mwan musin tsütsü apà Yɛsu, dweelà a làbe lun'bwiy u mɛɛn, lun'ni a ngwal. Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàŋän dweelà a làbe, waa kàkɔɔr mwan awun, kun'fuur akà taarànde.
Baar banswà bàkäl unsà ubem muman ibaŋ a Nzam. Yɛsu an'fàkyään nkweel ande (Màt 17.22-23; Mlk 9.30-32) Mbuur wanswà kàkäl mubem ndaa kàkyerà Yɛsu, nde kàtɛn a alɔŋki ande naa:
« Làkäär ndaa alàkyään mɛ yi apanà: Mwan a mbuur bàkyer ayun'yälà kà an'kɔɔ a baar. »
Wɛ alɔŋki ande bàyöb anki ndaa ayi. Mbuul a ya bàkyer ayee ntɔn ba bàkɔ̈ɔ̈n ayöb. Ba bàmɛn bɔɔmà mufuul Yɛsu mbuul a ya.
Nà awà mbuur a kölàköl
Isür kyàkyer abilà uboo a antööm: ba bàkwen muyöb naa nà kan'söön uboo a ba.
Yɛsu kàyöb nde an'kyän aba, nde kàtɛ mwan umbɛy mpi u kɔɔ, kun'si tsütsü apà nde,
waa kàtɛn a ba naa: « Mbuur awal mwan wà kà ikɔb amɛ, nde kan'wal mɛ ŋakwo, waa mbuur kàman'wal, nde kan'wal mbuur kan'töm. Ntɔn mbuur awà ikikye uboo abɛ, nde awun awà mbuur a kölàköl. »
Mbuur mpa afàkyer bɛ ube wà anà bɛ
Ywan waa kàsɛmà mutɛn naa: « Un'lɔɔŋ, bi kàmɛn mbuur mwɛy wàmuböŋ an'dweelà an'be kà ikɔb angye, wɛɛ bi kun'tsüŋ mukyer abun ntɔn nde ngye ufalab anki anà bi. »
Yɛsu waa kàfuur naa: « Twon làmutsuŋ, ntɔn mbuur mpa afàtɔn bɛ, nde wà anà bɛ. »
Bul mwɛy là Samalya lan'tɔn muwal Yɛsu
Taaŋ a Yɛsu mulwomà u mɛɛn làkäl tsütsü mukwo, nde kàsi ukwen mbɔɔn mukyà Yɛlusàlɛm.
Nde kàtöm akyeey kusà ande. Mpal bàkäl ba u mbwo, ba bàbilà u bul mwɛy là Samalya ntɔn mukun'yiil ikal.
Wɛɛ baar a Samalya bàtön mukun'wal ntɔn nde kàkäl mukyà Yɛlusàlɛm.
Mpal bàmɛn ba abun, alɔŋki ande Zyak anà Ywan bun'lɔ̈ɔ̈m naa: « Mwol, ipɛ mbwo bi iswɛŋ ipar a mbaa ifi du, kyabweel, waa ba bàkuŋà. »
Wɛɛ Yɛsu kàbulà nde ntsü bàkäl ba, waa kaŋän.
Waa ba bàkyen bul asin.
Yɛsu bun'lab aben
Mpal bàkäl ba u mbwo, mbuur mwɛy kàyi nde, kàtɛn a Yɛsu naa: « Mɛ in'kyer ayalab ntsü yanswà ayàkyà ngye. »
Yɛsu waa kun'fuur naa: « In'kyɛŋ mye anà an'fu, nɛn a du ye anà an'yaab, wɛ Mwan a mbuur ikal musà un'tswe kyatɛy. »
Yɛsu waa kàtɛn a mbuur mwɛy naa: « Yan'läb! » Mbuur awà waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Mwol, an'pɛ mbwo mɛ in'tàkàdyee taa. »
Yɛsu waa kun'fuur naa: « Wɛy akü bàdyee akü aba. Wɛɛ ngye, kyen kapay làsaŋ a Imwol a Nzam! »
Mbuur asin waa kàtɛn a nde naa: « Mɛ in'kyer ayalab, wɛɛ ngye tan'pà mbwo mɛ in'kàpà atɔŋ amɛ mbɔr a ntsüü. »
Yɛsu waa kun'fuur naa: « Mbuur kan'sà kɔɔ ande mulem ywaŋ ande anà kan'wɛy la ntɔn mukyer undiir asin, nde ukwe anki uboo a Imwol a Nzam. »
